title: pterocarpus pedatus
intro: Pterocarpus pedatus, commonly known as the African chestnut or stink tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, thanks to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of P. pedatus are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource for the treatment of various diseases.
